summary: Frontend-only exhaustive sweep of the FROM-ZERO navbar rebuild (Nav.jsx + useAdminSession.js module cache). Every spec item from the review request was reproduced on the live preview URL. All critical behaviours pass: visitor-only POSTULER header CTA, menu structure (NAVIGATION / TON ESPACE or LE CONSEIL / LE BUTIN), zero admin-leak, zero duplication, VOUS Y ETES/YOU'RE HERE states on /suivi and /donations with clicks being no-ops, recruit live reactivity without closing the menu, admin menu switch within ~1s of login via gp-auth-changed (NO reload needed), REGISTRE click lands on /admin with ZERO login-form flashes (polled DOM every 30ms for 6s, 0 flashes), menu stable 4s untouched, mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow, EN translations correct, logout flips menu back to visitor. Zero /auth/me calls during 5 SPA menu navigations (cache works). donations-hall-total count = exactly 1. No console errors beyond the pre-existing benign 401 noise.

suivi_page.vous_y_etes_label_present: SUIVRE MA CANDIDATURE — VOUS Y ETES

cache_correctness.note: Initial-load count of 8 is likely React StrictMode double-mounting Nav+Footer; the guard only protects against SECOND calls once the first resolves. All subsequent in-app navigation = 0 calls. Not blocking, but could be reduced by setting checkedOnce synchronously inside the useEffect before firing refreshAdminSession.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): 8 /auth/me calls fire on initial cold load (React StrictMode double-mount of Nav+Footer races the checkedOnce flag). Guard it synchronously inside refreshAdminSession by flipping checkedOnce=true BEFORE awaiting the request so the second subscriber short-circuits. Not blocking — SPA navigation is already 0.
critical_code_review_comments: useAdminSession.js: checkedOnce is set only AFTER the request resolves, so concurrent StrictMode double-mounts of Nav+Footer can both see !checkedOnce and both fire /auth/me (observed 8 calls on cold load). Flip the flag synchronously at the top of refreshAdminSession() to debounce.
Nav.jsx is clean, well-structured, ~310 lines, no duplication. Good use of module-level cache + listeners pattern.
Pre-existing: 401 console noise on home page from other requests — unrelated to this change but worth cleaning long-term.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all spec items; 1 minor non-blocking observation

seed_data_creation: None. localStorage.gp_bottles was set/cleared during tests and logged out at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav rebuild is solid. If main agent fixes the initial 8-call StrictMode race, quick retest = reload / and count /api/auth/me requests (should drop to 1-2). SPA menu nav already yields 0.
rca of the issue: Original bug (buttons flipping / login-form flash) was caused by useAdminSession re-firing /auth/me on every pathname change inside both Nav and Footer. The rebuild moved the result to a module-level cache (isAdminCached + checkedOnce + listeners Set) with gp-auth-changed as the only invalidation trigger. Verified: polling the DOM every 30ms during the REGISTRE click found ZERO login-form flashes, and 5 in-app menu navigations produced ZERO /auth/me calls.
